$env:PYTHONPATH=$root
python -c @"
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(r'$root'); PY=sys.executable
env=dict(os.environ); env['PYTHONPATH']=str(ROOT)+os.pathsep+env.get('PYTHONPATH','')
tmp=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
print('tmp',tmp)
b=subprocess.run([PY,'-m','pip','wheel','.','--no-build-isolation','--no-deps','-w',str(tmp)],cwd=str(ROOT),env=env,capture_output=True)
print('build rc',b.returncode, b.stdout.decode()[-300:])
whl=sorted(tmp.glob('hone-*.whl'))[0]; print('whl',whl)
v=tmp/'venv'
c=subprocess.run([PY,'-m','venv',str(v)],env=env,capture_output=True)
print('venv rc',c.returncode, c.stderr.decode()[-300:])
vpy=v/('Scripts/python.exe' if os.name=='nt' else 'bin/python')
i=subprocess.run([str(vpy),'-m','pip','install','--no-index','--no-deps',str(whl)],cwd=str(ROOT),env=env,capture_output=True)
print('install rc',i.returncode); print(i.stdout.decode()); print(i.stderr.decode()[-500:])
sp=v/('Lib/site-packages' if os.name=='nt' else 'lib/python3/site-packages')
print('site-packages exists', sp.exists())
print(sorted(p.name for p in sp.iterdir()) if sp.exists() else 'none')
env2=dict(os.environ); env2.pop('PYTHONPATH',None)
r=subprocess.run([str(vpy),'-c','import sys;print(sys.path);import hone;print(hone.__file__)'],cwd=str(tmp),env=env2,capture_output=True)
print('import rc',r.returncode); print(r.stdout.decode()); print(r.stderr.decode())
"@
